players.bio: Agustín Federico Marchesín (born 16 March 1988) is an Argentine professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Spanish club RC Celta de Vigo and the Argentina national team. He began his career with Lanús, making 222 appearances and winning the Copa Sudamericana in 2013.

Alan Agustín Velasco (born 27 July 2002) is an Argentine professional footballer who plays as a winger for Argentine Primera División club Boca Juniors. Velasco started his career in the youth system of Independiente, having joined the club in 2012.

Ander Herrera Agüera (Spanish pronunciation: ; born 14 August 1989) is a Spanish professional footballer who plays for Zaragoza in the Primera Federación – Group 2. Herrera began his career at Zaragoza, before moving to Athletic Bilbao in 2011 and then to Manchester United for €36 million in 2014.

Ángel Rodrigo Romero Villamayor (born 4 July 1992) is a Paraguayan professional footballer who plays as a winger for Campeonato Brasileiro Série A club Corinthians and the Paraguay national team. He is the twin brother of Óscar Romero.
Ayrton Enrique Costa (born 12 July 1999) is an Argentine professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Boca Juniors.

Camilo Rey Domenech (born 10 March 2006) is an Argentine footballer who plays as a midfielder for Primera División club Boca Juniors. Rey Domenech started his career in Sportivo Pilar football academy. When he was 10 he joined youth academy of Boca Juniors. In December 2024 he signed his first professional contract with Boca Juniors.
Carlos Enrique Palacios Núñez (born 20 July 2000) is a Chilean footballer who plays as a midfielder for Argentine club Boca Juniors and the Chile national team.
Cristian Franco Lema (born 24 March 1990) is an Argentine professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Boca Juniors.

Edinson Roberto Cavani Gómez (born 14 February 1987) is a Uruguayan professional footballer who plays as a striker.. Cavani began his career playing for Danubio in Montevideo, where he played for two years, before moving to Italian side Palermo in 2007. He spent four seasons at the club, scoring 34 goals in 109 league appearances.

Enner Remberto Valencia Lastra (born 4 November 1989) is an Ecuadorian professional footballer who plays as a forward for Liga MX club Pachuca and captains the Ecuador national team. Valencia previously played for Emelec in Ecuador, where he won the 2013 Ecuadorian Serie A and was awarded the Copa Sudamericana Golden Boot in 2013.
Javier Hernán García (born 29 January 1987) is an Argentine professional football goalkeeper who plays for Boca Juniors in the Argentine Primera División.
Jorge Nicolás Figal (born 3 April 1994) is an Argentine professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Boca Juniors.
Lautaro Emanuel Blanco (born 19 February 1999) is an Argentine professional footballer who plays as a left-back for Argentine Primera División club Boca Juniors.

Lautaro Federico Di Lollo (born 10 March 2004, in Buenos Aires) is an Argentine professional footballer who plays for Boca Juniors and the Argentina national under-20 football team as a defender. Career He signed his first professional contract with Boca in July 2022, a four-year contract until 2026.
Leandro Leonel Brey (born 21 September 2002) is an Argentine professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Boca Juniors.

Leandro Daniel Paredes (born 29 June 1994) is an Argentine professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder for Boca Juniors and the Argentina national team. He was part of the squad that won the 2022 FIFA World Cup.

Marco Pellegrino (born 18 July 2002) is an Argentine professional footballer who plays as a defender for Serie A club AC Milan. Born in Buenos Aires, in a family with Italian origins, Marco Pellegrino first played youth tennis at high level, before switching to football.
Miguel Ángel Merentiel Serrano (born 24 February 1996) is a Uruguayan professional footballer who plays as a forward for Argentine Primera División club Boca Juniors.
Milton Delgado (born 16 June 2005) is an Argentine professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder for Boca Juniors.
Milton Giménez (born 12 August 1996) is an Argentine professional footballer who plays as a striker for Argentine Primera División club Boca Juniors.
Rodrigo Andrés Battaglia (Spanish pronunciation: ; Italian: ; born 12 July 1991) is an Argentine professional footballer who plays as a defender for Argentine Primera División club Boca Juniors.

Tomás Leandro Aranda (born 9 May 2007) is an Argentine professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Boca Juniors. Club career Born in Ciudadela just outside of Buenos Aires, Aranda grew up in Villa Udaondo, where he played for Club Atlético Ituzaingó, before joining Boca Juniors in 2018.
Tomás Belmonte (born 27 May 1998) is an Argentine professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Primera División club Boca Juniors.

Williams Héctor Alarcón Cepeda (born 29 November 2000) is a Chilean footballer who plays as a midfielder for Argentine Primera División side Boca Juniors. As a youth player, Alarcón was with club Juanita Aguirre from Conchalí, Santiago, before joining Colo-Colo, where he coincided with Rodrigo Ureña.
